summary: Exact nine-file lifecycle-to-serving-v4 patch and portable target checker approved for separately authorized additive product packaging. No product or runtime source application by this review.

checks.author_files_and_inputs: All nine original file pins and four evidence pins unchanged; additive portability note separately bound.
checks.snapshot_correspondence: All 407 serving-v4 captured files rehashed; 374 files identical to lifecycle base; nine patch targets comprise six changed and three added files. The other 24 new standalone component data/entrypoint files are intentionally excluded.
checks.complete_patch_replay: git apply --check/apply in fresh temporary roots reproduces all nine complete target byte strings. Unified diff target inventory exactly equals manifest.
checks.reader_provenance: Exact AST source segment for capture matches bound originating reader and its declared hash; bounded descriptor/read and path-continuity behavior tested.
checks.prerequisites: Both v1 after-state checks executed before v2 checks; stream uses exact local lifecycle tree, host uses temporary copy of complete recorded target. Overlapping bill/module v1-after hashes equal v2-before hashes.
checks.portability: Relocated bundle checker tested with source roots containing spaces and file-open trap prohibiting historical source paths. Local replay tests explicitly require evidence paths.
checks.licenses: Both license texts byte-identical to preserved v1; local-target fingerprints do not imply stock upstream compatibility.
checks.immutability: All 818 review input hashes verified immediately before review publication.

independent_cases: Relocated checker excludes historical source reads and full replay identity
Dangling new-target and directory collision rejection
Changed patch rejection before target reads
Exact read limit and same-byte inode replacement rejection

findings.detail: Original target checker is not a full prerequisite checker. PORTABILITY.md explicitly sequences both v1 after-state checks before v2 application and discloses local-evidence replay dependencies.

reviewer_development_note: Initial correspondence helper assumed diff --git headers; supplied valid unified diff uses ---/+++ headers. Initial helper preserved; corrected header inventory passes. No author source changes were needed.
limitations: Trusted reviewed adjacent manifest/patch boundary; not a signed package or hostile-manifest validator.
Target hashes and absent new files do not establish whole dependency-tree compatibility. Rebase/port differences require explicit review.
Embedded portable_tests.zig imports the pinned engine/SDK and is not standalone. Optional CPU oracle helpers are not part of this bundle.

Prior source/scalar/static artifact evidence is referenced at its original scope. This review performs no native compilation, engine execution, model loads, numerical/performance qualification, GPU or lease action.
Actual serving, compressed-path hardware behavior, adapter equivalence, long-context fit, performance and generated quality remain separately gated.
